integration.productionLayer: SqliteAgentStoreLayer(options): Layer<EventStore | AgentStore | HarnessCursors | BoundedEventReplacement, StoreFailure>
integration.fixtureConstructor: openSqliteEventStore(options) returns {service: EventStoreService, agentService: AgentStoreService, cursorService: HarnessCursorsApi, appendBounded, close}
integration.writer: Both services share one existing node:sqlite DatabaseSync connection; AgentStore mutations use its serialized IMMEDIATE transaction and owner close is one atomic metadata update.
integration.legacy: EventStore signatures and mocks are unchanged; SqliteEventStoreLayer still provides only EventStore.
integration.cursor: cursorService is bound to the same native connection. Optional putIfCurrent(ref,expected,next) compares every StoredCursor field in one write transaction; memory uses Ref.modify.
integration.replacement: appendBounded(batch,{maxRemovedRecords,maxRemovedBytes,maxElapsedMs}) verifies bounded old-row metadata and exact body bytes before replacement in the same append transaction. Returns exact removal count, up to 500 IDs with an omission count, canonical body digest and measured work.
integration.measuredMetadata: readBasisMetadata(handle,cap), readLatestBasisMetadataForScope(scope,cap), readResultMetadata(handle,cap) and readMatchingResultMetadata(basis,capability,digest,cap) return actual stored UTF8 header bytes and inspected header rows. Cap refusal is null/0/1; missing is null/0/0. Latest/matching use indexed selections. Compatibility getters retain typed failures.
integration.measuredCursor: readCursor(handle,cap) checks persisted cursor bytes before materialization, returns actual admitted bytes and one inspected row, and validates identity/generation/epoch/basis/result/digest/projection/axis/positions through indexed scalar fields without decoding analysis headers. Cap refusal is null/0/1; missing is null/0/0. Legacy getCursor remains available.
integration.pageBudget: readResultPage counts one mandatory header fact, gates the combined persisted summary/disclosures/resolutions bytes in SQL before materialization, and counts every admitted or refused candidate. A one-fact budget does not advance item or series positions.
integration.historicalPlan: getOperationPlanForReceipt(operation) validates the recovered receipt, original reservation and retained immutable plan through primary-key lookups. Historical validity is presentation only; original args/scope/digest remain unchanged and apply checks are not relaxed.
integration.terminalRecovery: Ordinary reset/restore retains only exact consumed terminal bindings and the explicitly preserved administration operation. Receipt rebinding changes top-level store identity/generation and owner metadata while preserving original state, revision, timestamps, steps and effects. Recovery-only reservations cannot create fresh authority; all invalidated active0 reservations and unused planned bindings deny apply.
integration.migration8: CREATE INDEX agent_operation_aliases_operation ON agent_operation_aliases(operation_id). No event body, analysis input, semantic version, policy or contract digest is rewritten. Controlled v7-to-v8 reopen preserves identity, basis, result and original reservation.
integration.aliasWork: Existing aliases for a retained operation point directly to its current receipt after each generation move. Flattening uses the operation_id index; reservation guards use primary-key lookups and bounded alias verification. Invalidation streams capped receipt bodies, but total metadata work grows with retained receipt/alias history and physical SQLite I/O is not measured.
admin: invalidateAgentState(db, reset | restore | replacement, {preserveOperationId?}) runs inside the existing admin transaction.
AGENT_RECOVERY_TABLES excludes operation plans, receipts, steps, reservations, aliases and writer owners from destructive restore copying.
tombstoneAgentScope(db,repoId) removes retained source details and continuations while preserving authored learning.
tombstoneReplacedAgentEvents(db,adapterId,fromOccurredAt) prevents source replacement from redirecting retained references.

supportedBehavior: Migration from pre-agent stores, reopen identity, half-open indexed source selection and immutable captured watermark/coverage/scope binding.
Full retained analysis inputs, exact captured prices and policy/version metadata, immutable canonical digest binding and indexed ordered result rows.
Metadata getters check optional decoded-byte caps in SQL before body decoding; exact-scope latest basis uses a canonical scope index.
Measured basis/result/cursor reads report actual admitted stored bytes, including noncanonical JSON encoding, and report a refused matching row before decoding it.
Cursor validation uses indexed scalar bindings without hidden analysis-header JSON reads; page budgets include the mandatory retained header and gate all its JSON fields before materialization.
Current coverage uses indexed latest rows and observed source placements, preserving recorded gaps and explicitly disclosing unresolved branch/tool/worktree placement.
Harness cursor updates use atomic compare-and-set on the same store writer, preventing cross-process token-offset overwrites even when file metadata is unchanged.

Bounded replacement uses an adapter/time range index and LIMIT maxRemovedRecords+1, refuses record/byte/time limits without durable effects, and preserves prior observations when no replacement selector is supplied.

Operation plans, exact idempotency reservations, revision-and-owner CAS, append-only step journals and cancellation that preserves execution ownership; failed execution state is terminal and cannot resume through raw receipt CAS.

Reset/restore invalidates mutable plans and continuations; exact consumed terminal reservations and preserved active administration receipts recover through direct generation aliases without replay, including more than sixteen generation changes.
Receipt-bound historical reviewed plans survive reset/restore aliases without granting stale plan authority; missing retained plans return null while the receipt remains available.
Each writer open records a random session nonce, PID and process start identity. Reopen interrupts only a closed, absent or reused-PID owner; active or unverified owners are preserved.
Authored investigations/lessons retain immutable revision history; evaluation append is independent of parent CAS and idempotent, with indexed exact evaluation retrieval.
References check store identity, generation, scope and historical learning revision; missing evidence remains unavailable.
Index-only schema 8 migration preserves compatible v1 analysis interpretation and immutable retained inputs.

retention.aliasPolicy: Recovery aliases retain origin metadata for durable consumed bindings. Metadata history grows with retained operations and generation changes; aliases are flattened for bounded recovery lookup. No deleted event, basis or result bodies are preserved by terminal recovery.
retention.projectionPolicy: Oldest projections and indexed rows are evicted at the cap; stable metadata survives and content reads return basis-content-unavailable.
retention.authoredPolicy: No implicit eviction of authored learning, evaluations or operation journals. Per-record byte bounds apply.
